sentence_quote: I find that a fit sentence in this case is a term of 90-days’ imprisonment, served intermittently.

offence_note: Manslaughter by youth; YCJA s. 94 custody review
sentence_quote: I therefore order, pursuant to s. 94(19), that Mr. D. be released from custody and placed on conditional supervision for the remainder of his total sentence.
note: Review not appeal: 3-year youth sentence stands but remaining custody converted to conditional supervision with curfew.

offence_note: Aggravated assault and assault with a weapon
sentence_quote: substitute a conditional sentence of 2 years less 7 days taking account of pre-sentence custody and give 10 months’ credit for time served
note: Conditional sentence lengthened from 6 months; 14 months less 7 days left after credit; house arrest first 7 months.

offence_note: Sexual interference, two drug trafficking counts, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal where necessary and allow the appeal but only to the extent of setting aside the cumulative victim surcharges of $600.
note: Indeterminate sentence for sexual interference upheld; concurrent 6y drug and 2y breach sentences not appealed; surcharges set aside.

sentence_quote: the appellant received a custodial sentence of two years less a day and s. 109 firearms (10 years) and SOIRA (20 years) orders.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon and assault causing bodily harm on daughter
sentence_quote: On September 4, 2020, B.H. received an eight-month sentence plus two years of probation, following his convictions for assault with a weapon and assault causing bodily harm.
note: Five months plus three months consecutive; leave granted, appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Robbery causing serious injuries to victim
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the appeal is dismissed.
note: Blended sentence length not shown; court says aboriginal status should not much change sentence for serious crime.

offence_note: Theft over $5000 and two frauds against employer spa
sentence_quote: Consequently I sentence Ms. Lee to ten months in jail and direct that she be taken into custody.
note: Breach of trust aggravating; conditional sentence refused.

offence_note: Seven credit card fraud and forgery-instrument offences
sentence_quote: The appellant was convicted of seven credit card fraud-related offences and sentenced to two years less a day’s imprisonment followed by two years’ probation.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, sentence appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, breaches of bail, intimidating justice participant
sentence_quote: allow the appeal to the extent only of reducing the sentence on Count 2 of Information 37036-1 to four years and four months, after giving credit for pre-sentence custody of one year and eight months (or 20 months).
note: Prison before credit computed: count 2 is 52 months plus 20 credit, plus 12 months consecutive; Summers credit adjustment.

sentence_quote: a conditional sentence of eighteen months is imposed on the conditions agreed to by counsel
note: Trial sentence two years less a day custody replaced by 18-month conditional sentence; about six months already served.

offence_note: Offences not shown; appeal on enhanced pretrial lockdown credit
note: Sentence length not shown; 528 days pretrial custody, request for extra lockdown credit rejected.
